text: dsh-session-tabs 是 DSH Web GUI 插件，在窗口标题栏下方加入整宽会话标签栏，并把标签放入可折叠的工作区分组。点击标签可切换会话，加号可新建会话，关闭按钮只移除标签而不删除会话；标签和分组状态保存在浏览器本地存储中。它还会标示正在运行的会话，并支持横向滚动，适合希望从顶部快速切换多个会话并按项目整理标签的用户。

dsh-session-tabs adds grouped session tabs to the DSH Web GUI. Click to switch sessions, fold workspace groups, start a session, or close a tab while keeping its session. The strip marks running sessions and scrolls horizontally; tab and group state stays in browser storage.
我想在 DSH 页面顶部直接点标签切换已打开的会话。
能不能把不同项目的 DSH 会话分组收起来，需要时再展开？
dsh-session-tabs 的功能「工作区会话标签」：在窗口顶部按工作区分组显示已打开会话，点击标签即可切换；点分组标题可折叠或展开，当前会话所在分组会自动展开。
dsh-session-tabs 的功能「标签管理」：点击加号通过当前工作区服务新建会话；关闭按钮或中键点击移除标签但保留会话，并在关闭当前标签时切换到相邻标签。

dsh-session-tabs README · dsh-session-tabs：**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

> 给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Web GUI 装一条**浏览器式的顶部标签栏**：一个标签 = 一个会话，同一个项目的会话收在一个可折叠的框里，点一下就切过去。左侧栏从此可以关掉，正文也能更宽。

dsh-session-tabs README · 为什么会有这个插件：DSH 原来靠左侧栏在会话之间跳：侧栏必须一直占着宽度，切过去还要先点开列表、再在几十行里找。这和浏览器的体验是反的——浏览器里开着的页面永远在顶部排成一排，一眼看到、一下点到，不占正文空间。

这个插件把「开着的会话」变成窗口顶部的一排标签，把「项目」变成可以收起来的框：

- 想切会话，**抬头点一下**就行，不用翻侧栏；
- 觉得侧栏碍事，**直接收起**，标签栏照样在；
- 项目太多时，把不看的项目**折叠**成一个 `项目名 3` 的小框，需要时再展开。

dsh-session-tabs README · 一眼看懂：**展开状态**——两个项目各一个框，框里是会话标签：

**折叠状态**——点项目名就收起来，只剩 `项目名 + 标签数`，状态会记住：

**细节**：

> 左边 `⌄ DSH-论文格式 1` 是一个项目框：`⌄` 表示已展开，`1` 是这个项目里开着的标签数，点框头即可折叠成 `›`。
> 右边是会话标签：**蓝色胶囊 + 加粗**是当前会话；标签前的小蓝点表示那个会话的 agent 正在输出；标签上的 `×` 只关闭这个标签，不删会话；最右侧 `+` 新建会话。

dsh-session-tabs README · 特性：- ✅ **一条整宽标签栏**，钉在窗口标题栏的正下方、从最左到最右，装上后界面整体让出 38px，不遮挡任何官方 UI。
- ✅ **一个标签 = 一个会话**：当前会话是浅蓝胶囊 + 加粗；正在输出的会话，标签前有呼吸的蓝点。
- ✅ **按项目分组、可折叠**：每个工作区一个带边框的圆角框，框头 `⌄ 项目名 + 标签数`。折叠状态保存在 `localStorage`，刷新/重启后依然是收起的。
- ✅ **标签按需创建**：只有你真正打开过的会话才会出现，不会一装就把上百个历史会话铺满；标签按打开顺序排列，对话持续输出时也不会左右乱跳。
- ✅ **`×` 只关标签，不删会话**：会话、历史、项目原封不动，回到侧栏点一下标签就回来。关掉当前标签会自动切到相邻标签；只剩一个标签时不显示 `×`（不会把标签栏关空）；中键点标签也能关。
- ✅ **`+` 新建会话**，就在标签栏最右侧。
- ✅ 标签多了自动横向滚动（在标签条上滚轮即可），两侧边缘渐隐提示还有内容。
- ✅ 当前会话被别处切走（侧栏、快捷键、深链）时，它所在的框会自动展开。
- ✅ **纯客户端、零依赖、无构建**：装完即用，不喜欢随时停用，界面立刻恢复原样。

2. 删掉遗留的目录：`C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-session-tabs`（只删这一个目录，不会影响你仓库里的源码）；
3. 再用方式 A / A-2 的地址安装，3 秒左右完成。

dsh-session-tabs README · 实现：- 数据来自客户端服务：`sessions.list`（会话与摘要）、`workspaces.list`（项目与归档状态）、`uiWorkspace.openSession(id)`（打开会话）、`uiWorkspace.startSession()`（新建会话）。
- 可见性规则与官方侧栏一致：隐藏子代理会话、非当前的空会话、已归档会话。
- 插件停用或卸载时会撤掉注入的 `<style>` 并移除根属性，界面立即恢复原样。

dsh-session-tabs README · 已知限制：- 在 DSH 桌面端（Windows，页面带 `data-windows-titlebar`）验证；纯浏览器窗口里没有那条原生标题条，标签栏会直接贴在窗口顶部（仍然可用）。
- 标签宽度上限 200px（CSS 变量 `--st-tab-max`），超长标题截断为 `…`。
- 至少保留一个标签；`×` 不会把标签栏关空。
- 只支持 Web 平台（`dsh.client.platform = "web"`），没有 TUI 版本。

dsh-session-tabs README · dsh-session-tabs：[中文](README.md) · **English**

> A **browser-style tab bar** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) Web GUI: one tab per Session, Sessions of the same Workspace collected in a collapsible box, one click to switch. Close the sidebar for good — your tabs stay.

dsh-session-tabs README · Why this exists：DSH switches Sessions from the left sidebar, so the sidebar has to stay open and wide, and switching means opening a list and hunting for a row. That is the opposite of how a browser feels: the pages you have open sit in a row at the top, visible at a glance and one click away, taking no room from the content.

This plugin turns the Sessions you have open into a row of tabs, and each project into a box you can fold away:

dsh-session-tabs README · At a glance：**Expanded** — one box per project, Sessions as tabs inside it:

**Collapsed** — click the project name and it folds down to `name + tab count`; the state is remembered:

**In detail**:

dsh-session-tabs README · At a glance：> On the left, `⌄ DSH-论文格式 1` is a project box: `⌄` means expanded, `1` is how many tabs are open in that project, and clicking the box head folds it into `›`.
> On the right are the Session tabs: the **light-blue bold pill** is the current Session; a small blue dot means that Session's agent is streaming; the `×` only unloads the tab, it never deletes the Session; the `+` at the far right starts a new Session.

dsh-session-tabs README · Features：- ✅ **One full-width strip**, pinned right below the app's own title strip, edge to edge. The GUI is pushed down by 38px so nothing is covered.
- ✅ **One tab per Session**: the active tab is a light-blue pill in bold; a Session whose agent is streaming gets a pulsing blue dot.
- ✅ **Grouped per project, collapsible**: each Workspace is a bordered, rounded box headed by `⌄ name + tab count`. The folded state lives in `localStorage`, so it survives a reload or a restart.
- ✅ **Tabs are created on demand**: only Sessions you actually opened show up — installing this will not flood the bar with hundreds of old conversations. Tab order follows the order you opened them, so nothing jumps around while a conversation streams.
- ✅ **`×` unloads a tab, never deletes a Session**: conversation, history and project stay untouched, and clicking the Session in the sidebar brings the tab back. Closing the active tab switches to a neighbour; with a single tab the `×` is hidden (the strip can never be emptied); middle-click also closes.
- ✅ **`+` starts a new Session**, at the far right of the strip.

dsh-session-tabs README · Usage：| Action | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Click a tab | Switch to that Session |
| `×` on a hovered / active tab | Unload that tab (**the Session stays**) |
| Middle-click a tab | Same as `×` |

dsh-session-tabs README · How it works：- Client-only plugin. The Host half is empty and there is **no build step**: `index.js` + `client.js` are runnable ESM as committed.
- It renders into `shell.overlay` (the frame-wide floating layer). The DSH frame has no top-row slot, so the strip is pinned right below the title strip and the frame is pushed down by 38px with a single `:has()` rule:

dsh-session-tabs README · How it works：- Data comes from client services: `sessions.list` (Sessions and summaries), `workspaces.list` (projects and archive state), `uiWorkspace.openSession(id)` (open a Session), `uiWorkspace.startSession()` (new Session).
- Visibility rules match the official sidebar: subagent Sessions, non-current blank Sessions and archived Sessions are hidden.
- Disabling the plugin removes its injected `<style>` and the root attribute, so the GUI returns to its normal layout at once.

dsh-session-tabs README · Known limitations：- Developed and verified against the DSH desktop app (Windows, page carries `data-windows-titlebar`). In a plain browser window there is no native title strip and the bar simply sits at the top of the window — it still works.
- Tab width is capped at 200px (CSS variable `--st-tab-max`); longer titles are truncated with `…`.
- At least one tab is always kept; `×` will not empty the strip.
- Web platform only (`dsh.client.platform = "web"`); there is no TUI version.
